title: Recover stalled royal-queue bridge and add watchdog

payload.goal: Recover and harden royal-queue synchronization so current status is accurate, completed/superseded jobs cannot reappear as waiting_human or stale tracking reminders, and new COSHUMA tasks are ingested exactly once.
requirements: Inspect watcher, GitHub bridge, dashboard and routing processes; safely restart only failed or stuck local queue processes using existing scripts/config. Do not read or expose secrets.

Fetch and reconcile the royal-queue branch exactly once per UUID. Select one winning state per UUID using explicit status/result semantics and freshness; directory name alone is not terminal evidence.

Terminal done/failed/superseded results must override older waiting_human copies. waiting_reply/escalated vendor-support states such as apply-semrush are not waiting_human unless an actual CAPTCHA, legal acceptance, payment approval, credential/OTP step, or forced human verification is currently required.
Reconcile todo, in_progress, done, failed and waiting_human counts against actual authoritative files after every sync; stale directory duplicates must not be resurrected on the next cycle.

Remove legacy dashboard tracking rows automatically once their authoritative task is rejected or has an approved tracking link that is live-verified; completed tracking reminders must not persist indefinitely.
Restore periodic generation of status/latest.json and status/dashboard.json and persistent heartbeats. Embedded liveness data from an old snapshot must never be treated as current process health.
Add or repair a zero-cost watchdog that detects stale status generation or dead bridge/watcher/dashboard processes and safely restarts or surfaces failure without spawning duplicate workers.

Prove the durable repair with at least one subsequent branch change followed by fresh latest/dashboard generated_at timestamps, correct deduplicated counts, and no resurrection of stale waiting_human or tracking records.

Keep COSHUMA tasks 62e114d0-a161-4a40-a768-c39b2d60d4fb and 24bb2f8d-36c5-4d53-9a46-234220e66019 plus Work task 8c8a6f94-5db6-4c38-bb0f-7d77a9c0d72f unique and eligible for normal routing; do not recreate completed UUIDs.
No payments, no production deploy, no account changes, no CAPTCHA handling, and no secrets access.

github_fallback_repair.behavior: Deduplicate by UUID using explicit status/result semantics plus freshness; regenerate latest/dashboard; mark old local process heartbeats stale instead of treating them as current; drop completed legacy tracking rows when the authoritative task is rejected or its approved tracking link is verified/live.

scheduled_watchdog_root_cause.observed: No schedule event ran at the next 00:17 UTC boundary even though the cron existed on royal-queue; Actions history stopped at push Run 33125796560 from 23:18 UTC.
scheduled_watchdog_root_cause.cause: The reconcile workflow existed only on the non-default royal-queue branch. GitHub scheduled workflows execute from the repository default branch, which is main, and main did not contain .github/workflows/royal-queue-reconcile.yml.

default_branch_schedule_fix.pr_title: fix: enable hourly royal-queue reconcile on default branch
default_branch_schedule_fix.change: Copied the existing reconcile workflow to main. The scheduled job still checks out ref=royal-queue and writes only royal-queue status snapshots.
default_branch_schedule_fix.next_verification: Continue checking event=schedule history. Treat schedule delivery as unproven until an actual scheduled run appears; do not mark this UUID done based only on push/manual success.

fallback_runtime_probe.action: Re-ran the existing successful reconcile job as a zero-cost fallback after scheduled events remained absent.
fallback_runtime_probe.result: latest.json and dashboard.json regenerated at 2026-08-28T02:26:51.068284+00:00 with unchanged deduplicated counts and no stale waiting_human/tracking resurrection.

observations: Push-triggered GitHub reconciliation remains healthy, with semantic counts todo=3, in_progress=2, done=36, failed=7, waiting_human=6 and tracking=[].

PR #22 correctly placed the cron workflow on main, but GitHub Actions still reports zero event=schedule runs after the first three expected hourly boundaries (01:17, 02:17, 03:17 UTC), so scheduled watchdog delivery is still unproven.

The current latest/dashboard snapshot is generated at 2026-08-28T02:30:31.701047+00:00, while the affiliate audit task has a fresher updated_at of 2026-08-28T02:32:00Z; this probe intentionally updates the existing recovery UUID to trigger the healthy push-based reconcile path without creating a duplicate task.

A zero-cost rerun of existing reconcile Run 33132338437 attempt 2 previously succeeded and refreshed latest/dashboard without resurrecting stale UUIDs; this is only a fallback proof, not proof that cron scheduling works.

The 148-tool affiliate audit UUID is correctly resolved as in_progress despite copies in todo/done because its explicit internal status is in_progress; directory name alone is not treated as terminal evidence.
Semrush remains correctly in_progress/waiting_reply rather than waiting_human; no automatic reapplication is permitted while vendor support is pending.
Old local process heartbeats remain explicitly labeled stale_remote_observation; GitHub-side reconciliation does not pretend to know current local PID health.
Local watcher/bridge/dashboard restart and persistent local heartbeat recovery remain unfinished, so this UUID stays open until the local execution surface is durably recovered.
current_evidence.prior_evidence: Detailed recurrence history is preserved in git history through commit dc3c32d13dac81fd5f92718af42a1c64dea5dfdc and later reconciliation commits.
